# h3_s3_bucket (Resource)

Manages an S3 bucket. `name` and `project_id` force a new (empty) bucket. The S3 access key of the project is returned only when a bucket is created; it is shared by all buckets of the project and is kept in state (mark outputs sensitive, protect the state). After import it is empty. Import with `<project_id>/<bucket_name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "h3_s3_bucket" "assets" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  name       = "assets"
}

output "s3_access_key_id" {
  value     = h3_s3_bucket.assets.access_key_id
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bucket name

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID). Defaults to the provider `project_id` (`H3_PROJECT_ID`). Changing it replaces the bucket.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) S3 access key ID of the project (returned only on create)
- `created_at` (String) Bucket creation timestamp
- `id` (String) `<project_id>/<name>`
- `region` (String) Bucket region, when reported
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) S3 secret access key of the project (returned only on create)
- `slug` (String) Bucket name in the S3 storage

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<bucket_name>
terraform import h3_s3_bucket.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/assets
```
